integrity: Exact coefficient and covariance identities are analytically derived. Exhaustive finite-state calculations support but do not replace proof. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The independent two-back attachment model has a fixed interior parameter; the theorem does not cover longer memory, parameter changes with sample size, or independence of height and leaves at finite size.
title: A golden-ratio covariance transition for height and leaves of Bernoulli recursive trees
